description: Linked forward Income Statement / Balance Sheet / Cash Flow projection, seeded from the company's latest historical annual period. The balance sheet ties out (assets == liabilities + equity) EVERY projected year by algebraic construction — each year's `tie_out_ok` field is a live correctness check, not decoration. Interest is computed on beginning-of-period debt balances (no circular cash-sweep/revolver solve — deterministic by design). Gross margin, operating margin, and the combined D&A + working-capital adjustment are held at the seed period's ratio-of-revenue unless overridden; interest_rate_on_debt and tax_rate are ASSUMPTIONS (no historical InterestExpense concept exists in the dataset). Every simplification is listed in the response `caveats[]` — read them before presenting this as a precise forecast. Returns a `fcf_stream` usable directly as `compute_dcf`'s `fcf_source:"three_statement"` input. Plan: Benchmark and above.

as_of_date.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD) for the seed period. Omit to use the latest knowable annual period.

capex_pct_of_revenue_override.description: Override the seed period's capex-as-%-of-revenue ratio. Leave unset to use the historical ratio.

cash_sweep_pct.description: Fraction (0-1) of each year's free cash flow swept to debt paydown. Default 0 (going-concern; use ~1.0 for an LBO-style paydown).

dividend_payout_pct.description: Fraction (0-1) of net income paid out as dividends each year. Default 0.

gross_margin_pct_override.description: Override the seed period's gross margin (held flat across all years). Leave unset to use the historical ratio.

interest_rate_on_debt.description: Annual interest rate on beginning-of-period debt. Assumption — default 0.06.

new_debt_draw_year1.description: New debt drawn at year 1 only (absolute USD) — e.g. acquisition financing. Default 0.

new_equity_draw_year1.description: New equity contributed at year 1 only (absolute USD) — hits cash + equity symmetrically. Default 0.

operating_margin_pct_override.description: Override the seed period's operating margin. Leave unset to use the historical ratio.

revenue_growth_rate.description: Flat annual revenue growth rate applied every year (e.g. 0.08 = 8%/yr).

tax_rate.description: Effective tax rate on positive pretax income. Default 0.21 (US statutory).

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL, MSFT, BRK.B.

years.description: Projection horizon in years (1-15). Defaults to 5.

name: project_three_statement

_meta.description: Response metadata (provenance, point-in-time flag, freshness, request id and warnings). Every field is documented once in the agent contract (agent_contract.meta in the server's manifest.json).
